project_management.hero_sub1: It's not distribution, nor budgeting. It's not even getting your script right.
project_management.hero_sub2: It's project management — and hardly anybody talks about it.
project_management.problem_title: Each tool does its job well.
project_management.problem_title_highlight: The problem is they don't speak to each other.
project_management.problem_desc: The industry is full of useful tools. Scriptwriting apps. Budgeting software. Cloud drives. Task boards. Each works in isolation. Together, they quietly destroy shared context.
project_management.problem_card_title: The questions no one can answer on set.
project_management.problem_q2: Has the budget been updated after that location change?
project_management.problem_q3: Which version of the script did we shoot from?
project_management.problem_q4: Who confirmed the call time for tomorrow?
project_management.problem_bottom: No one teaches you that you're managing a business, not just making a movie.
project_management.os_desc: Filmmakers don't just need a place to store files. They deserve a place where their projects are connected and alive.
project_management.os_card1_desc: Scripts, breakdowns, schedules, communication, budgets, tasks, and files all live in the same environment — so when something changes, the production knows.
project_management.os_card2_desc: No more scattered versions. Everyone sees the same evolving state of the production, from the director to the line producer to the crew.
project_management.os_card3_desc: AI operates within the complete production environment — not in isolation. It helps teams move faster without losing alignment.
project_management.os_card4_title: Your First AD, Line Producer & Post Supervisor — in one place
project_management.os_card4_desc: Pzaz is project management cleverly disguised as filmmaking software. An AI-enhanced command centre for the entire production.
project_management.os_footer_highlight: It's the infrastructure your film has always needed.
project_management.banner_h1: Pzaz doesn't add another tool to the pile.
project_management.banner_h2: It puts the whole production in one place.
project_management.banner_desc: Scripts, schedules, breakdowns, budgets, tasks, files, and communication — all inside the same environment. No plug-ins. No exports. No scattered information.
project_management.stats_desc: After working with hundreds of filmmakers, one pattern appears again and again.
project_management.stat1_label: of first-time filmmakers don't make a second film.
project_management.stat1_note: Not because of creativity. Because of burnout, overwhelm, and disorganisation.
project_management.stat2_note: The creative challenge is rarely the film itself. It's the system — or lack of one — behind it.
project_management.stat3_label: of successful productions run on clear infrastructure.
project_management.stat3_note: Behind every smooth shoot is a quiet system keeping the creative process moving forward.
project_management.stats_quote: "Investors walk. Distributors bail. Or worse: you get the film made, but you're so exhausted and disillusioned, you don't even want to be near it again."
project_management.stats_quote_note: The creative challenge wasn't the film. It was the system behind it.
project_management.shift_pill: The Shift You Need to Make
project_management.shift_desc: The story matters. But the structure that carries it matters just as much.
project_management.shift1_title: Teams communicate less, but understand more.
project_management.shift1_desc: When context is always visible, teams don't need to chase updates. Decisions move faster because the information is already there.
project_management.shift2_desc: Administrative overhead disappears. The system handles the coordination so the team can focus on the film.
project_management.shift3_title: The film still needs talent, persistence, and vision.
project_management.shift3_desc: But at long last, the system supporting it no longer works against you. It becomes your co-pilot.
project_management.shift_bottom_highlight: For those who understand that creating a film is just one part of the job. The rest is execution.
project_management.usps_pill: A System Designed for Production Reality
project_management.usps_title_highlight: Fully Unified from the Ground Up
project_management.usps_desc: Some platforms claim all-in-one. Behind the scenes, they rely on loosely connected modules and bolt-on tools. Pzaz is different — every function is designed to work together in real time.
project_management.usp1_desc: Scripts, breakdowns, schedules, budgets, tasks, files, and communication all live in the same environment — structurally connected by design.
project_management.usp1_highlight: No plug-ins. No exports. No scattered information. Just a production system that behaves like a production system.
project_management.usp2_desc: When a scene changes, the schedule reflects it. When a location is updated, the call sheets adjust. Production context is always preserved.
project_management.usp2_highlight: The production knows when something changes — without anyone having to tell it.
project_management.usp3_desc: AI tools operate within the complete project environment, assisting with script development, planning, and prioritisation — not just generating lists.
project_management.usp3_highlight: AI doesn't decide what happens next. It makes sure the people who do decide can see clearly.
project_management.usp4_desc: Teams communicate inside the production structure itself. Discussions stay attached to the scenes, tasks, and files they refer to.
project_management.usp4_highlight: Communication stops being noise around the production and becomes part of it.
project_management.usp5_desc: Scripts, budgets, schedules, and files always reflect the current state of the project. No more asking which version is right.
project_management.usp5_highlight: Everyone sees the same evolving picture of the production — always up to date.
project_management.usp6_desc: Control who sees what across departments. Sensitive financials stay private. Creative references stay accessible.
project_management.usp6_highlight: The right information reaches the right people at exactly the right moment.
project_management.usp7_desc: Plan production in focused periods — pre-production phases, shoot weeks, and post-production milestones — all visible in one timeline.
project_management.usp7_highlight: Teams know what this week looks like. Nothing important falls between the cracks.
project_management.usp8_desc: See budget utilisation, task completion, schedule progress, and team activity in one live view — not assembled from five separate tools.
project_management.usp8_highlight: Leadership sees the whole picture. Departments see their lane. Everyone stays aligned.
project_management.cta_title: If you want to keep making films, make Pzaz your co-pilot.
project_management.cta_desc: With Pzaz, the system supporting your production finally works with you — not against you.
project_management.cta_body: Start managing your projects with clarity. Create without friction.
